adversarial_lines.detail: Two dedicated red-team nodes with verdicts and evidence. N-0005 (capability-skeptic): partially holds — agents unreliable long-horizon, ~10% firm adoption, so large end-to-end substitution overestimated in 2020-25; but the strong 'never arrives' claim is not supported (reliability horizon extrapolating). N-0007 (accelerationist): only locally hits — AI-attributed layoffs real and rising but tiny vs total churn and not the primary driver, so aggregate 'mild' is not a pure measurement artifact; strong form (large net loss already here) fails. Hypothesis-B lag line (N-0009) also carries orientation=adversarial. Each red-team result is captured, not just asserted.
